channel.title: POOPIEMATE stories and guides
channel.description: Stories and dog guides from POOPIEMATE, the dog potty log your whole family shares

item.title: Should You Feed Your Dog More in Winter? And Which Dogs Need a Coat?
item.description: Should you feed your dog more in winter? Which dogs need more food (long walks, lots of play) and which gain weight indoors, which dogs need a coat, why double-coated dogs like Jindos don't, and how to pick a warm coat.

item.title: "Did Anyone Feed the Dog?" Stop Asking: Tummy Gauge, Food Logs and Med Reminders
item.description: POOPIEMATE now logs meals, treats, drinks and meds: a tummy gauge on Home, meal and monthly medicine reminders (like NexGard), tracing diarrhea back to yesterday's food, timing walks with the pee and poop gauges, and skipping a meal after too many treats.

item.title: Dog Constipation: Causes, How to Help at Home, and When to See a Vet
item.description: Common causes of dog constipation, from too little water to bones and holding it, how to help at home, and the signs that mean see a vet now.

item.title: Why Does My Dog Have Diarrhea? When to Watch at Home and When to See a Vet
item.description: Common causes of dog diarrhea, from a sudden food switch to parasites, parvo and pancreatitis, what to try at home, and the signs that need a vet now.

item.title: Evacuating With Your Dog in a War or Disaster: Korea, Japan, the US and Ukraine
item.description: Can dogs enter shelters? How Korea, Japan, the US and Ukraine handle pets in war and disaster, and a dog emergency kit checklist to prepare now.

item.title: Why Do Dogs Only Potty Outside and Not at Home?
item.description: Why some dogs only potty outside: the clean-den instinct, scent marking and walk habits, plus how to add an indoor backup for bad weather.

item.title: How to Get the Perfect Poop: From Switching Dog Food to the 10% Treat Rule
item.description: How to get healthy, firm dog poop: set mealtimes, a 7–10 day schedule for switching food, water and walks, the 10% treat rule, and probiotics and fiber.

item.title: Kibble, Cooked or Raw: Which Diet Gives the Best Dog Poop?
item.description: How dog poop amount, smell and firmness differ on kibble, cooked and raw diets, the hygiene risks of raw, and how to switch food safely.

item.title: Should You Leave the Heat On for Your Dog When You Go Out?
item.description: Whether to leave the heat on for a dog home alone: the right indoor temperature (18–22°C), dogs that feel the cold, hot floor burns and heater safety.

item.title: Is It Bad for Dogs to Hold Their Pee and Poop? Risks and Tips
item.description: What holding pee and poop can do to outdoor-only dogs, how many hours is commonly OK, and what to do on rainy, stormy or freezing days.

item.title: How Often Do Puppies Poop and Pee? By Age and Dog Size
item.description: How many times a day puppies poop and pee by age, the "months + 1 hour" rule, small vs. large dog differences, and when to worry.

item.title: Why Do Dogs Kick After Pooping? Should You Stop It?
item.description: Why dogs kick the ground after pooping: paw scent, visible scratch marks and simple relief, plus when to redirect it and when to see a vet.

item.title: Why Do Dogs Like to Poop on Dry Leaves?
item.description: Why dogs pick dry leaf piles to poop on: scent, soft footing and early habits. Plus why they circle first, leaf-pile hazards and how to pick it up cleanly.

item.title: Yellow or Gray Dog Poop: What It Means and When to See a Vet
item.description: What yellow, gray or white dog poop can mean, from food and fast gut transit to bile, pancreas and parasite problems, and when each one needs a vet.

item.title: Two Working Parents? How to Never Miss a Dog Walk or Mix Up Whose Turn It Is
item.description: For dual-income homes: keep dog walk times on track and stop mixing up whose turn it is by seeing who walked the dog and when.

item.title: Jindo Mix Potty Training: Why Does It Feel So Hard?
item.description: Jindo mixes are smart and independent, so knowing their outdoor potty pattern matters most. Breed traits, training tips and how to keep a log.

item.title: Raising Multiple Dogs? How to Keep Their Potty Logs Straight
item.description: In a multi-dog home it's easy to lose track of whose poop is whose. Log each dog in its own profile and share it with your family.

item.title: How to Track Potty for a Dog Who Only Goes Outside
item.description: With an outdoor-only dog, only the walker knows if they went. Log it right after the walk and share it with your family in the app.

item.title: Dog Poop Color Chart: What Healthy Dog Poop Looks Like and What Each Color Means
item.description: A dog poop color chart (or poo colour chart): what healthy poop looks like, what brown, yellow, gray, black, red or green can mean, and when to see a vet.

item.title: How Often Should a Dog Poop? Daily Potty Count and Intervals
item.description: How many times a day puppies, adult and senior dogs poop, what a normal potty interval is, and when to talk to a vet.

item.title: How to Share Your Dog's Potty Log with Family in Real Time
item.description: Skip the chat screenshots and notes. Share your dog's poop, pee and walk records with the whole family in real time, with one tap in the free POOPIEMATE app.

item.title: What Is a Dog Walk Safety Index? Is It Safe to Walk Today?
item.description: Check if today's walk is safe on a 1 to 5 scale from feels-like temperature, chance of rain and your dog's size, age and coat. Plus summer and winter tips.

item.title: From developer to solo builder: the POOPIEMATE story
item.description: Leaving ComfyUI and building POOPIEMATE alone, from design and code to store reviews and marketing: 120 first users, then the 2.0.0 family care app.

item.title: Why I built POOPIEMATE
item.description: The dog we first saw on a rescue group’s Instagram, and the “Did she poop?” calls we made every single day.
